card.change: Ensemble-refine the scored attempt-11 parent while treating attempt 12's joint personalization as unsupported. Reproduce the attempt-7-equivalent 24-feature context/session member, attempt-8-equivalent 30-feature predecessor-proxy member, and attempt-11 36-feature target-free personalized member, including uniform binary LightGBM, 63 leaves, learning_rate=0.05, 240-round ceiling, last-three-date chronological split, exact within-user GAUC/nDCG@5 selection on rounds 20,30,...,240, full-data refit, frozen user vocabulary, causal user_id/time_ms/physical-order sequencing, and within-user average-tie percentile ranks. Replace attempt 12's six higher-order user crosses with one 42-feature member that nests the 36 parent features and adds: previous-tab code; previous/current tab-transition code; a base-3 ordered pattern of the latest four available predecessor-proxy states (missing, negative, positive); an eight-event capped signed proxy streak; log elapsed time in the current 30-minute session; and mean log duration over up to four completed predecessor impressions. All six use only the current timestamp/context and earlier rows. First reconstruct attempt 10 and attempt 11 locally, then choose a single weight from {0,0.125,...,1} between the exact reconstructed attempt-11 rank blend and the ordered-history member. Accept nonzero history weight only for at least 0.0005 chronological-primary gain; otherwise emit the exact parent. Persist all four boosters, selected rounds and weights, vocabulary, feature/history contracts, schema and causal-order audits, metric paths, coverage, and rank divergence. Final mode loads only the checkpoint and label-free evaluation_features.
evidence: STATE:attempt 1 ended in candidate_error because evaluation_features lacks play_time_ms, so deterministic target reconstruction remains unexecutable and no current-row outcome operand is used.

STATE:attempt 2 hit LightGBM's 10000-row query limit; attempt 3 correctly debugged it but scored GAUC=0.4391458020855132, nDCG@5=0.46472532822498236, primary=0.4519355651552478. The LambdaRank family is therefore not reopened.

STATE:attempt 4's uniform pointwise binary objective improved primary to 0.5136198093284867, while attempt 5's per-user class-balanced weighting collapsed it to 0.4015359629325522. Every member keeps uniform binary loss.

STATE:attempt 6 removed raw user/content IDs, metadata, and all target-rate tables from attempt 4 and improved to GAUC=0.6529519405185545, nDCG@5=0.5859802565307765, primary=0.6194660985246655. The new member restores none of those rejected sparse or label-derived families.

STATE:attempt 7 added only strictly backward gap and session-position features and improved primary to 0.656265027500125; attempt 8 added the causal predecessor-duration proxy and improved primary to 0.6576323250719152, with GAUC rising to 0.675356308327958. These are the strongest controlled results supporting additional causal session representation.

STATE:attempt 9's fixed within-user rank blend improved primary to 0.6597195902662226, and attempt 10's organizer-consistent chronological round/weight selection improved it to 0.6600453866842653. The candidate preserves their rank geometry and exact holdout metric implementation.

STATE:attempt 11 added dense target-free user-by-single-context personalization behind a 0.0005 chronological gate and is the validation best: GAUC=0.68523199907238, nDCG@5=0.6615192821191637, primary=0.6733756405957718. Its three members are reconstructed as the protected parent.

STATE:attempt 12 added explicit user-by-joint-context categories but returned exactly attempt 11's metrics, showing that its local gate selected zero new-member weight. Higher-order static personalization is abandoned rather than retuned from the controller outcome.
EDA:user-history-density-and-support reports a median 3489 training rows per user and p90 11662, providing repeated within-user sequences for short ordered histories and stable session transitions.

EDA:tab-context-distribution reports large scenario differences, including long_view rates 0.3194828108 on tab 1, 0.0395547152 on tab 0, and 0.4310815981 on tab 4, motivating a causal previous-tab/current-tab transition rather than another static user cross.

EDA:validation-cold-item-rate=0.7422197404 and EDA:item-frequency-and-tail singleton fraction=0.6706248142 support continued omission of raw video/content identifiers; every added feature is computed from confirmed inference columns.

Feedback:candidate-review-1788212895844887351 permits backward time since the same user's preceding impression and prohibits forward deltas; Feedback:candidate-review-1788217862347170707 verified the causal sequence path and metric safety of within-user percentile ranks. The accepted KuaiRand dataset paper documents dense sequential behavior, with the limitation that its random-exposure claims are not used here.
card.falsifier: Reject executability if a required inference field is absent; the user vocabulary is missing, unsorted, or inconsistently encoded; a tab transition, base-3 pattern, or signed streak exceeds its frozen range; any feature, model score, percentile rank, or blend is non-finite; sequence construction accesses a next/future row or loses, duplicates, or reorders an authoritative row; ensemble weights are off the frozen 1/8 grid or do not sum to one; or checkpoint-only final mode on the same label-free data_root fails to reproduce attempt predictions within controller tolerance. Treat ordered multi-step history as unsupported if fewer than 10% of chronological-holdout rows have a nonempty four-step proxy pattern or prior-tab history, if the history member has effectively zero rank divergence from the reconstructed attempt-11 blend, or if its unconstrained frozen-grid blend fails to improve reconstructed-parent chronological primary by 0.0005 and the gate sets its weight to zero. Reject practical improvement unless controller primary exceeds attempt 11's 0.6733756405957718 by the campaign's frozen epsilon. If the local gate passes but controller primary misses epsilon or falls, retain attempt 11, conclude that ordered short-horizon state overfit the three-day holdout, and do not tune windows, pattern coding, streak cap, gate, or weights from the controller result. If the gate fails, retain attempt 11 and abandon this longer causal-session refinement.
card.hypothesis: Attempt 8's causal predecessor proxy improved broad within-user ordering, but its recent-four mean discards which past impressions were positive or negative, their recency, streak structure, scenario transitions, and how far the current session has progressed. Attempt 12 showed that adding still higher-order static user-context crosses was not supported, so the highest-value refinement is to return to the measured sequence mechanism. A fourth member that retains ordered, strictly backward multi-step session state should distinguish attention persistence, fatigue, and scenario-switching regimes that have identical parent summary rates. Conservatively blending its within-user percentile rank with the exact attempt-11 ensemble should improve both broad pair ordering and top-five placement when that information transfers, while a frozen chronological gain gate preserves the incumbent otherwise.
